item.title: al-Sharaa: Golan will remain Syrian territory
item.description:
Syrian President Ahmed al-Sharaa addressed the UN General Assembly on Wednesday and declared that the Golan Heights are Syrian territory.
Any attempts that violate our sovereignty, violate international law, will be stopped. Golan will remain Syrian territory," al-Sharaa said.
